facts.fact: The Agence de Développement du Digital (ADD) is the organisation publishing a dataset of 1,028 Moroccan startups on data.gov.ma, whose resource was created and last modified on 2025-01-03 (dataset first created 2021-11-16); the document does not say who runs the portal or tie it to an open data policy.

The document shows data.gov.ma operating as a CKAN-based open data portal hosting datasets under an ODbL licence, with ADD as a listed publishing organisation; it does not state who runs the portal or tie it to an open data policy, and gives its date as the 2025-01-03 release.
